settings.question: What makes an office chair ergonomic?
settings.answer: An ergonomic office chair adjusts to the person sitting in it — seat height, seat depth, tilt and tilt tension, back height, lumbar support, and arms — so it supports a neutral, well-aligned posture rather than forcing one. Commercial task chairs add certified durability and weight ratings built for full-day or multi-shift use.

settings.question: Do you supply heavy-duty or big-and-tall ergonomic chairs?
settings.answer: Yes. We carry chairs rated to 400 and 500 lb and built for continuous use — for example the Global Robust multi-tilter at 500 lb capacity and the Offices to Go Raven 400 synchro-tilter rated for 24/7 occupancy. Tell us the weight and shift pattern and we will match the right model.

settings.question: Do you deliver and install ergonomic office chairs across Ontario?
settings.answer: Yes. Our own crew delivers, assembles, and places every chair across Ontario, and clears the packaging. Bulk orders arrive floor-ready — you are not unboxing cartons or booking a separate installer.

settings.question: Are your ergonomic chairs certified?
settings.answer: The task lines we carry are built and tested to recognised contract standards. The Global Robust is tested to exceed the BIFMA X5.11 large-occupant standard, and lines like the Offices to Go Format and Raven carry GREENGUARD Gold low-emission certification, with the Format also certified to BIFMA LEVEL. Ask us to confirm the certifications on any model you are quoting.

settings.question: Are any of your ergonomic chairs Canadian-made?
settings.answer: Yes. Global Furniture Group and its Offices to Go division build many of their task chairs in Canada, and we also carry Canadian-made ergonomic specialist ergoCentric. Ask us to flag the Canadian-made lines on your quote.

settings.question: Can Ontario institutions buy without an open tender?
settings.answer: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Call us and we will confirm your eligibility.
